text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition alone proves nothing. Women are now a majority of planning graduates and are common on municipal hiring panels; four women is unremarkable and would be sampled by chance fairly often. Raising it makes you look aggrieved and shifts attention from your actual grievance.

Your stronger point is substantive: a director post where a bachelor's degree and consultation experience outranked a master's, a licence and twelve years' practice. That may reflect a genuine council priority — political and community-facing skills often dominate at director level — or a weak process.

Focus on the unanswered request. Send a written follow-up citing the relevant records or civil-service rules, with a deadline. Get the selection criteria and scoring first; judge afterwards.
